_comment: Known conformance gaps. Two granularities are supported and can be mixed. Condition level entries are applied while adjudicating the module log (api/log/{id}); a rule that stops firing is itself a failure, so this file cannot silently rot.

_schemas.conditions: OIDF run-test-plan.py schema. test-name and configuration-filename accept shell wildcards; variant may be "*" or a partial map; current-block may be "*"; expected-result is 'failure' or 'warning'.
_schemas.modules: Harness shorthand. A module name mapped to a reason (or bare in expected-skips.json) is never started and is reported as a documented SKIP.
